name: Tony Ybarra
bio: Tony Ybarra is a Santa Barbara guitarist who plays flamenco, Latin styles and jazz, with six albums to his name. He founded Ybarra Music in 2002 to provide live music for weddings and events.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from ybarramusic.com and @ybarramusicsb.
